text:
Changing world order accelerating what was already the path.  Just steeper with this admin.  

I think bitcoins going to have a great 2027-29.   I don’t see it as rotation, just a hot meta to chase again.  I think it’s far too early for bitcoin to play any role similar to gold.  Trust on that scale takes decades. 

The debt only matters in terms of money supply/inflation.  Reflected in higher metals and asset prices. 

Only just finished this week rebalancing.  Mostly equal weight the other buckets to keep the balance.  But still overweight.
